verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs state that you can add a custom domain, manage DNS records, and get SSL certificates automatically. The CLI docs separately confirm DNS record and certificate management from the terminal or automated systems. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of attaching domains to specific projects or deployments (verification steps, apex vs. subdomain handling), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach custom domains to my deployed services

citations.quote: Add a custom domain, manage DNS records, and get SSL certificates automatically.
enabling you to retrieve logs, manage certificates, replicate your deployment environment locally, manage Domain Name System (DNS) records, and more.
